posts.title: On Conjuring Childhood Dreams and Being Somewhat Wrong
posts.description: A few days ago, I was at the pub with a friend. He showed me some games he vibe-coded across the past few months and inspired me: we started talking about creating our own ironic monster-catching RPG.
